pr_title: Introduce SslContextOption which can be used for "optional" features …
pr_body:
…in SslContext implementations

Motivation:

Some of the features we want to support can only be supported by some of the SslContext implementations. We should allow to configure these in a consistent way the same way as we do it with Channel / ChannelOption

Modifications:

- Add SslContextOption and add builder methods that take these
- Add OpenSslContextOption and define two options there which are specific to openssl

Result:

More flexible configuration and implementation of SslContext

issue_context.title: Make SslContextBuilder more "extensible"
issue_context.body:
At the moment we have a few things on various `SslContext` implementations that can only be configured by "casting". I think it would be better to introduce something like `ChannelOption` but for `SslContext` and so allow easier configuration and also changing things without breaking others.

So I think we should introduce `SslContextOption` which follows the pattern of `ChannelOption` and add something like:

`
SslContextBuilder.option(SslContextOption, value);
`
comments: Something like would also allow us to make it easier to setup key logging etc when using BoringSSL and so on.
I can get behind consistent, smaller and more flexible API surfaces.

review_comments: Consider clarifying the behavior difference when this option is enabled, like premature `SslCompletionEvent`
Do you plan to move `OpenSslSessionContext` (ticket-keys, session-cache-enabled) to `OpenSslContextOption` in follow-up PR(s)?
